name: CPU Usage
description: process_cpu_seconds_total, by worker instance, 2-minute timeshift delta.
programText:
raw = data('process_cpu_seconds_total', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum(by=['service.instance.id'])
((raw - raw.timeshift('2m')) / 120).publish(label='CPU Usage')
